sources.title: How much does Gelato+ subscription cost? (official help center, content not fully retrievable)

freePlan.limits: Full access to the print-on-demand production network, store integrations (Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce) and unlimited product creation, without the Gelato+ discounts and extras.

keyLimits.en: Full production network access, unlimited product creation, Shopify/Etsy/WooCommerce integrations, no discounts or branded packaging.

Adds product discounts (up to 25%, up to 35% in the first subscription year), branded packaging options, advanced mockup tools, the Creative Vault image library and unlimited storefronts; exact price could not be confirmed directly on the official help center article, which did not return its full pricing content in this session.
Higher-volume tier with custom pricing, above Gelato+; exact terms not public.

cautions.en: The official Gelato support article on Gelato+ pricing did not return its full pricing content to automated fetch in this session; the USD 19.99-23.99/month figures come from a third-party tracker and should be re-verified against the live official page.

Free plan already includes unlimited product creation and full production network access; Gelato+ is a discount/perks subscription layered on top rather than a feature unlock, which changes how it should be evaluated against other print-on-demand tools.

capabilities.en: Print-on-demand platform with a distributed local production network, printing and shipping orders from facilities close to the end customer.
Native integrations with e-commerce platforms including Shopify, Etsy and WooCommerce for automated order fulfillment.
Design and mockup tools, plus a stock image library (Creative Vault) for product design.

limitations.en: Product quality and print options can vary by region since orders route to different local production partners.
Full store branding tools and product discounts require the paid Gelato+ subscription rather than being available on the free plan.

reason.en: Direct print-on-demand competitor with a comparable free-plus-paid-tier model and similar e-commerce integrations.
Order fulfillment and shipping platform that overlaps with Gelato's fulfillment role for e-commerce sellers, though less specialized in print-on-demand.

missingAlternatives.name: Printful
missingAlternatives.reason: One of the largest print-on-demand competitors to Gelato, not present in the catalogue.

unknowns: Exact current Gelato+ monthly/annual price could not be confirmed directly from the official support article (content did not load fully); figures rely on a third-party tracker.
Platinum tier pricing and exact terms are not public.
conflicts: Different third-party sources report Gelato+ monthly pricing anywhere from $19.99 to $29.99, and annual pricing around $19.99/month; could not reconcile against the official page within this session's budget.
